name: ZETRIX
recent: Zetrix AI 近期围绕未付清股息与债权人 Macquarie Bank 及政府机构发生多项法律与监管事项：公司取得 interim court order 阻止 Macquarie 就 RM2 million 股息付款提出的清盘行动，同时 Bursa 驳回其延长支付 FY2025 未付股息的申请。政府就 RM314 million JPJ 欠款起诉公司，公司另提出以 RM100 million 预付款恢复 JPJ 收款角色。
notable: 公司取得 interim court order，阻止 Macquarie Bank 就 RM2 million 股息付款提出的清盘行动。
政府就 RM314 million JPJ 欠款起诉 Zetrix AI。
公司提出 RM100 million 预付款，以恢复 JPJ 收款角色。
risks: MARC Ratings 将 Zetrix AI 的 sukuk 下调至 default，涉及未支付的 RM25 million。

earnings: 截至 2026-06-30 季度，营收为 RM426.719 million，环比增长 10.5%，同比增长 38.6%；净利为 RM269.252 million，环比下降 0.8%，同比增长 35.2%；净利率为 63.1%，低于上一季度的 70.2%。

recent_en: Zetrix AI has recently been involved in several legal and regulatory matters over unpaid dividends and claims from Macquarie Bank and a government agency: it obtained an interim court order to block a winding-up action by Macquarie over a RM2 million dividend payment, while Bursa rejected its request to extend the deadline for paying outstanding FY2025 dividends. The government is suing the company over RM314 million in JPJ arrears, and the company has offered a RM100 million upfront payment to regain the JPJ collection role.
notable_en: The company obtained an interim court order to block a winding-up action by Macquarie Bank over a RM2 million dividend payment.
The government is suing Zetrix AI over RM314 million in JPJ arrears.
The company offered a RM100 million upfront payment to regain the JPJ collection role.
risks_en: MARC Ratings downgraded Zetrix AI's sukuk to default over an unpaid RM25 million.
Macquarie Bank issued a statutory demand over a RM2 million dividend payment, which may lead to a winding-up petition.
Bursa rejected the company's request to extend the deadline for paying outstanding FY2025 dividends, and the company has not paid all outstanding dividends to unaffected shareholders.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM426.719 million, up 10.5% QoQ and 38.6% YoY; net income was RM269.252 million, down 0.8% QoQ but up 35.2% YoY; net margin was 63.1%, lower than 70.2% in the previous quarter.
